detail.title: Revision: Cognitive Foundations of Personal Identity
detail.summary: Personal identity is sustained through the recursive process of autobiographical memory and narrative integration. Evidence confirms that identity is not a static archive but a reconstructive process, where the 'self' is shaped by the framing of past experiences.
detail.reason: Revising established findings with new source integration regarding narrative construction.

detail.title: Epistemological Foundations of Observer Disagreement
detail.summary: Observer disagreement in scientific contexts is often driven by subjective epistemological frameworks and cognitive biases rather than mere data scarcity. Framing and interest-driven selection function as filters that create persistent interpretive differences.
detail.reason: Project is synthesis_ready and requires a provisional notebook.
